subject: Is there an easy way to switch off info messages?

messages.author: 5feb68cbfe09079c
messages.subject: Is there an easy way to switch off info messages?
parts:
Example:

    The 'fixef' method has been revised in brms 1.7.0.
    To get the old output, set argument 'old' to TRUE.

This is helpful when fixef is called interactively but not necessarily when run as part of  a script.  For instance, when I compile my somewhat largeish knitr document, the output is littered with hundreds of these messages which makes it difficult to spot warning and error messages.  Perhaps, suppress the message when the user explicitly sets the old parameter to FALSE, or have a global switch, or emit messages only when interactive() returns TRUE? Not sure what's the best approach. I think I like the first option most.

  Titus
